description: This file defines a PHP class 'vtigerRSS' for handling RSS feed retrieval, display, and management within the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for fetching RSS feeds from URLs, displaying them in various formats, saving RSS URLs, and managing user-specific RSS preferences.

classes.name: vtigerRSS
classes.description: A class for managing RSS feeds, including fetching, displaying, saving, and deleting RSS feed data within the vtiger CRM system.

methods.name: setRSSUrl
methods.description: Fetches and sets the RSS feed from the given URL, parsing items and metadata.

methods.name: getListViewRSSHtml
methods.description: Generates HTML for listing RSS feed items; shows up to 10 items.

methods.name: getListViewHomeRSSHtml
methods.description: Retrieves RSS items for display on the home page, limited by max entries.

methods.name: saveRSSUrl
methods.description: Saves a new RSS feed URL into the database with optional starred status.

methods.name: getCRMRssFeeds
methods.description: Retrieves and generates HTML for user-specific starred RSS feeds.

methods.name: getAllRssFeeds
methods.description: Retrieves and generates HTML for all non-starred RSS feeds.

methods.name: getRssUrlfromId
methods.description: Fetches RSS URL by RSS feed ID.

methods.name: getRSSHeadings
methods.description: Generates HTML showing RSS feed details and headings.

methods.name: getTopStarredRSSFeeds
methods.description: Returns HTML snippet of top starred RSS feeds.

methods.name: getStarredRssHTML
methods.description: Gets HTML for starred RSS feeds, including their list items.

methods.name: getSelectedRssHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML for specific RSS feed identified by ID.

methods.name: getRSSCategoryHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML structure for RSS categories.

methods.name: getRssFeedsbyCategory
methods.description: Returns HTML listing RSS feeds by category.

methods.name: trash
methods.description: Deletes an RSS feed entity from the database based on ID.
